title: Android Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

Build the Android experience at the heart of our new Customer Portal. We are looking for a Software Engineer (Android) to join Group Technology and help shape a secure, reliable and accessible application used across critical customer journeys. Working within a multidisciplinary product team, you will have the opportunity to influence the technical direction, engineering standards and future evolution of a brand-new digital product.

We offer a hybrid working arrangement with 2 days per week in our Milton Keynes office.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Design, build, test and maintain native Android features using Kotlin and Jetpack Compose
  • Develop secure, accessible, responsive and high-performing customer journeys aligned to agreed designs and engineering standards
  • Apply maintainable architecture, modularisation, reusable components, state management and established design-system patterns
  • Integrate Android applications with RESTful APIs, identity services, push notifications and analytics platforms
  • Write clean, well-documented and testable code, participating actively in design discussions, code reviews and pair programming
  • Build and maintain automated unit, integration and user-interface tests to support reliable delivery
  • Investigate defects and production issues, contribute to root-cause analysis
  • Monitor application performance, reliability and observability, using data to identify and resolve issues
  • Contribute to continuous integration and delivery pipelines, application signing and Google Play releases

Experience and Skills Required:

  • 2 years commercial experience building and supporting customer-facing native Android applications
  • Strong Android engineering skills using Kotlin, Jetpack Compose and the Android development ecosystem
  • Understanding of maintainable application architecture, modularisation, reusable components and state management
  • Experience integrating RESTful APIs and working with identity, push notification or analytics services
  • Practical knowledge of mobile security, privacy, accessibility and the Android application lifecycle
  • Experience with automated testing, version control, continuous integration and delivery, and application deployment
  • Experience and knowledge of C#, .NET, SQL and Microsoft Azure
  • Working knowledge of Google Play release processes, application signing and phased deployment
  • Ability to diagnose defects and performance issues using logs, monitoring and debugging tools
  • Good communication and collaboration skills

Highly Desirable:

  • Experience with feature flagging, phased rollouts, remote configuration and experimentation
  • Experience implementing biometrics, deep linking, offline capability or secure local storage
  • Familiarity with Android performance profiling, crash reporting and application observability
  • Experience working with design systems and delivering accessible mobile experiences
  • Awareness of cross-platform technologies such as React Native or Flutter
  • Understanding of AI systems

What We Offer

  • Aviva Digicare + workplace / Car leasing and cycle to work scheme
  • Colleague discount scheme / Perks at work / Gym discounts
  • Life assurance / Workplace pension scheme
  • Collaborative agile environment
  • Ongoing professional development

Our Commitment to Inclusion

Connells Group is an equal opportunities employer committed to a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace. We welcome applications from all suitably qualified candidates regardless of ***, race, disability, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion or belief, marital status, or pregnancy and maternity.
